svg.title: Mechanisms that mesh
svg.desc: Mechanisms that mesh: the planetary gear stage seen from above, turning with the carrier held: sun 12, planets 18, ring 48 teeth; 1 : 5 with the ring held, 1 : 4 reversed with the carrier held.
svg.text: 1 : 5 with the ring held · 1 : 4 reversed with the carrier held
Involute gears from the parts library, meshed by
the agent and turned here by their own tooth
